title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Food Systems component will be implemented in Southern Province and will support 3,000 households (18,000 beneficiaries) to diversify from maize into more drought tolerant crops. Lead farmers will be trained in CSA techniques and drought tolerant seeds will be distributed. Boreholes will be drilled, and irrigation systems established. A Functional Landscape approach will be applied that balances economic needs with protection of the natural environment. Through the programme training will be conducted in post-harvest handling, food preservation and storage. Savings and credit groups will be established and links with credit and markets will be facilitated. As this component is implemented in a geographical area prone to both floods anddrought, communities will be supported to conduct risk assessments and put Disaster Risk Management plans in place. In both programme components information about rainfall and weather patterns will be collected and shared with farmers to inform their planning and decision making.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome 2: Equitable and inclusive food systems to support availability, access and consumption of safe nutritious food. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: Activities to promote access to nutritious foods
